basic_details.job_title: NIT Durgapur Research Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Mathematics at National Institute of Technology Durgapur is inviting Indian Nationals to apply for one Research Associate-I post in the DST-INSPIRE Faculty project "Characterized Subgroups of Locally Compact Abelian Groups", under Principal Investigator Dr Ayan Ghosh. The post pays INR 58,000 per month with accommodation/HRA as per Institute norm and requires a Ph.D degree. Applications go by email to [email protected] within 14 days of the advertisement dated 27 November 2026, that is, about 11 December 2026 (14 days from 27 November 2026).

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 14 days from the date of advertisement (about 11 December 2026)
important_dates.interview_date: Tentatively in the third week of December 2026

how_to_apply: Prepare a cover letter and a CV.
Collect your educational certificates (UG, PG, PhD) and one best publication.
Combine all of these into a single PDF file.
Email the PDF to [email protected] within 14 days of the advertisement.
Write the subject line of the email as: "Application for Research Associate 2026".
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. NIT Durgapur holds the full right of not selecting any candidate if suitable applications are not received. The post is purely temporary and gives no right to any post in the institute. Extension beyond the initial 6 months depends on project funds and the P.I.'s recommendation.

content_sections.heading: About NIT Durgapur
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Durgapur is the institute issuing this notice, and its Department of Mathematics hosts the project. The post sits under the DST-INSPIRE Faculty project led by Dr Ayan Ghosh, Assistant Professor in the department. The notice gives the department's web page as https://nitdgp.ac.in/department/mathematics and the phone number 0343-2754577.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals may apply for the Research Associate-I post. The upper age limit is 35 years as on the last date of application. A relaxation of 5 years applies to SC/ST/OBC/PWD and women candidates. The notice does not mention a minimum age or any experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility text.

rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D degree from reputed institutes/universities, with expertise in Topological Algebra and related areas
rows.preference: At least one research paper in a reputed SCI journal

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is INR 58,000 per month, with accommodation/HRA as per Institute norm. The position is purely temporary: initially for 6 months, and it can be extended up to 1 year, subject to availability of project funds and the recommendation of the P.I. at the end of the initial tenure. Selected candidates will have no right to claim, explicitly or implicitly, any post in the institute.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The Selection Committee will first shortlist applications on the basis of past academic record, match of past expertise with the desired requirements and other academic parameters. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email and called for an interview for the final selection. Merely satisfying the essential qualification does not guarantee that a candidate will be shortlisted for an interview. The interview is tentatively planned for the third week of December 2026. Shortlisted candidates will be told the venue and schedule by email.
